evals.prompt: Use $beacon-truth for a normal truth task. Stay inside HARD GATE.
Use $beacon-truth in mode `gen-truth` (authoritative truth package). Read references/modes/gen-truth.md first.
Use $beacon-truth in mode `gen-truth-init` (init feature package). Read references/modes/gen-truth-init.md first.
Use $beacon-truth in mode `gen-change` (change log / delta). Read references/modes/gen-change.md first.
Use $beacon-truth in mode `gen-refreeze` (refreeze after change). Read references/modes/gen-refreeze.md first.
